summary: Complaints centre on power cuts, waterlogging in the town, a filthy mandi and a child's death that villagers blame on a transformer, while the appreciation is a road widening under way plus district-level relief and cane payments.

round2.changes: Opened all 10 cited URLs and the Sikandrabad AC Wikipedia extent page. Power item: dropped the Bulandshahr-wide '15 to 25 minutes' claim, kept the Sikandrabad 33-fault figure. Waterlogging: changed 'bhar jaata hai' (recurring) to 'bhar gaya' (single 9 July event). Mandi: removed unverified 'fruit and vegetable' and GT Road and stray-animal details. Child death: confirmed 5-year-old, Kala Peer mohalla, Sikandrabad Kotwali. Factory: now 'Sikandrabad industrial area'. Arnia item: the source says a foundation stone was laid and the rajwaha roads are pledged, so 'work started' was replaced with the foundation-stone claim. Dadri widening: sourced stretch described (Dadri-Chitehra-Bulandshahr-Sikandrabad), unsourced power-pole detail removed. Crop relief and cane: kept as district-level; no local delivered benefit found in searches. Road item: 'this year' removed (not in source). Rewrote all Hindi to 12 words or fewer.

positives.english: The Dadri to Bulandshahr to Sikandrabad road is being widened with a median and drains
positives.hindi: दादरी-सिकंदराबाद सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, डिवाइडर बन रहा है
positives.basis: Source: 'दादरी से चिटहेरा होते हुए बुलंदशहर और सिकंदराबाद को जोड़ने वाली सड़क के चौड़ीकरण का काम तेजी से चल रहा है'; median divider, two lanes each side and drains being built; no length stated; the stretch inside this AC is not stated, Sikandrabad is only the endpoint (town counts as inside under the namesake rule)

positives.english: A foundation stone was laid for road construction and repair in Arnia Kamalpur village
positives.hindi: अरनिया कमालपुर गांव में सड़क निर्माण का शिलान्यास हुआ
positives.basis: Regional MLA laid the foundation stone for road construction and repair at Arnia Kamalpur village; the rajwaha roads (Vair km 3.30 to 8.30, Talada 2.5 to 4.75, Baroda 26 to 28.906, Hasanpur 10.20 to 13.60) are pledged or 'किया जाएगा' (future), not confirmed as started; no funding amount; article names Sikandrabad constituency and Sikandrabad area; AC membership of Arnia Kamalpur village unconfirmed (not named in the Wikipedia extent list, which covers all of Sikandrabad tehsil); published 12 Nov 2024

positives.english: Farmers got crop-loss relief certificates in the district after the late September rain
positives.hindi: सितंबर की बारिश से फसल खराब, जिले में राहत प्रमाण पत्र मिले
positives.basis: District-level: certificates for relief aid and agricultural input subsidy given at Bulandshahr collectorate auditorium from the State Disaster Mitigation Fund, for rain between 25 and 27 September 2026; number of farmers and amount not stated; no village or tehsil named

positives.english: Sugar mills in Bulandshahr say they paid farmers 100 percent of the cane price
positives.hindi: चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा किसानों के खाते में भेजा
positives.basis: District-level: four Bulandshahr mills say they sent 100 percent of 2025-26 cane dues, about Rs 1,092 crore, to farmers' bank accounts; mills named: Sabitgarh, Pahasu, Anamika, Agauta, Wave and Di Kisan; mill locations inside this AC not confirmed (Agauta is a name that may fall in the Agouta KC area, unverified); the figures are the mills' own statement

positives.english: A 5 km road costing about 10 crore was built in Sikandrabad
positives.hindi: सिकंदराबाद में करीब 10 करोड़ की 5 किलोमीटर सड़क बनी
positives.basis: Article: 'सिकंदराबाद की पांच किलोमीटर लंबी सड़क करीब 10 करोड़ की लागत से बनी है'; the road was dug up by Jal Nigam for a pipeline about four months after construction, so the benefit was short-lived; the damage is the article's main point, see negatives; the town counts as inside the AC under the namesake rule; published 6 July 2026

negatives.english: Power in Sikandrabad keeps going off because of tripping, with 33 faults reported
negatives.hindi: सिकंदराबाद में ट्रिपिंग से बार-बार बिजली गुल होती है
negatives.basis: Article: 'सिकंदराबाद क्षेत्र में 33 जगह फॉल्ट होने की शिकायत ऊर्जा निगम से की गई'; cuts of 'दो से लेकर आठ घंटे' reported from the town to rural areas (district-wide report); the 'हर 15 से 25 मिनट पर' claim is Bulandshahr-wide and is not used for this AC; Sikandrabad area is inside the Sikandrabad tehsil extent; published 27 May 2026

negatives.english: Rain left all the mohallas of Sikandrabad town waterlogged, in July
negatives.hindi: बारिश में सिकंदराबाद के सभी मोहल्लों में पानी भर गया
negatives.basis: Article (rain of Thursday 9 July 2026): 'सिकंदराबाद नगर के सभी मोहल्लों के अलावा औद्योगिक क्षेत्र और तहसील परिसर में तहसीलदार के आवास आदि जगह जलभराव'; Sikandrabad recorded 75 mm; a single event, not a stated recurring problem; the report is district-wide but names Sikandrabad nagar; published 9 July 2026

negatives.english: The Sikandrabad mandi is full of filth and its taps are broken
negatives.hindi: सिकंदराबाद मंडी में गंदगी का अंबार है, नल खराब पड़े हैं
negatives.basis: Article: 'मंडी परिसर में चारों तरफ गंदा पानी, कूड़े के ढेर'; 'मंडी में लगे नल खराब पड़े हैं'; commission agents announced an indefinite strike until the mandi's cleanliness, drainage and drinking water are fixed; strike status after 14 Aug 2026 not confirmed; published 14 Aug 2026

negatives.english: A five-year-old died from electric shock near a transformer, villagers allege complaints were ignored
negatives.hindi: ट्रांसफार्मर के करंट से बच्चे की मौत, आरोप है शिकायत अनसुनी
negatives.basis: Article: a five-year-old died from current on Sunday morning in Mohalla Kala Peer, Sikandrabad Kotwali area; current ran through the iron angle supporting a transformer on the path, which is unpaved and waterlogged; villagers allege the transformer lay there for many days and repeated requests to remove it went unheeded (allegation); published 31 May 2026

negatives.english: Workers at a Sikandrabad factory protest 12-hour shifts and low pay of about 8000 a month
negatives.hindi: महिला कर्मियों को 8 हजार वेतन, 12 घंटे की ड्यूटी
negatives.basis: Article: workers at a private company in Sikandrabad industrial area protested low pay and 12-hour shifts, demanding Rs 15,000 (women) and Rs 20,000 (men) minimum wage, and 8-hour days; the article reports women's pay of about Rs 8,000 a month; company not named; officials (ALC, SDM) promised to take demands to management; published 14 Apr 2026

notes: AC confirmed via Wikipedia list (no. 64 Sikandrabad, Bulandshahr, General). Extent per the Sikandrabad Assembly constituency Wikipedia page (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sikandrabad_Assembly_constituency), read via a summarising fetch: 'Sikandrabad Tehsil' in full, plus PCs Peerbiyavani, Chhapravat, Baral, Sainta, Kurli, Kota, Bhamra, Anchana, Girdharpur Navada, Gulaothi (Dehat), Auladha and Maholi, plus parts of Agouta KC and Gulaothi MB. Negatives recounted against this extent: all five are in Sikandrabad town, tehsil or industrial area, so 5 of 5 are AC-specific; the power item's place is the Sikandrabad area (33 faults), and the cut-hour and mandi-strike details are district or not yet confirmed. Positives: items 1 and 5 are Sikandrabad-specific; item 2 (Arnia Kamalpur) has an unconfirmed AC membership, since the village is not named in the extent list and was not found in any search; items 3 and 4 are district-level, and no local delivered crop relief or cane payment for this AC was found in searches. Dadri-Sikandrabad widening: the stretch inside the AC is not stated, Sikandrabad is the endpoint. Positive 5 is a road later dug up, so the appreciation is weak. Mandi strike status after 14 Aug 2026 is unknown. Excluded: Royal Bulletin strike report (Navin mandi, not this one), Amar Ujala Madhuban-Bapudham works (Ghaziabad), Hapur and Khurja waterlogging reports, a Khurja GT Road drain story, a social media post on a jan sunwai complaint, and the Sikandrabad power grid aggregator items. Field check suggested: Arnia Kamalpur membership and the rajwaha road status, Sikandrabad nagar drains and the Kala Pir transformer, the mandi strike status, the Dadri-Sikandrabad widening stretch, and a local crop-relief or cane-payment list for Sikandrabad.
